prompts: A 24-hour convenience store at night, heavy rain outside. Behind the checkout counter stands a young man, 22-26, with a thin long face, single eyelids, slightly messy short black hair, medium-slim build, wearing a dark blue short-sleeved uniform shirt under a matching dark blue vest, a name badge on his left chest, an old scar on his right wrist, black trousers, white sneakers. Medium shot, handheld camera slowly pushes in from the side toward his profile. Fluorescent white light from above, cold blue tones, rain streaks on the glass door behind him. He is scanning an item, then stops, turns his head to listen, puts down the scanner, and walks toward the glass door. Continuous motion, 5 seconds.

A medium close-up, landscape 832x480, shot from behind and slightly to the side of a young man as he leans close to a glass convenience-store door at night. He has a thin long face, monocular eyelids, slightly messy short black hair, a medium-thin build, and wears a dark blue short-sleeved uniform shirt under a matching vest with a name badge on the left chest; a faint old scar shows on his right wrist. Cold white store light falls on him from inside; outside the glass is a rain-lashed dark street. In the glass reflection, a soaked, pale figure with the same face and hair plastered to his forehead stands behind him. The man whips his head around — the space behind him is empty. He turns back; the reflection is normal again. He draws a slow, shaky breath and places his hand on the door handle. The camera pushes in very slightly. Cold, desaturated, claustrophobic tone.

Wide full shot, low fixed camera angle from wet pavement outside a 24-hour convenience store at night, looking slightly up. The storefront glows harsh white fluorescent light into a dark street drowned in heavy rain. A thin, medium-build young man with a long narrow face, monolid eyes, slightly messy short black hair, wearing a dark blue short-sleeved uniform shirt under a matching dark blue vest with a work badge on the left chest, black trousers and white sneakers, pushes the glass door open. In the rain stands an identical man — same face and hairstyle, hair plastered to his forehead, skin pale, soaked dark blue uniform vest without badge, black trousers, barefoot — who steps forward and raises a hand to block the door frame. The clerk recoils, pulling the door back. Cold blue-grey palette, rain streaks, reflections on wet asphalt.

A tight handheld close-up in landscape orientation, inside a brightly lit 24-hour convenience store at night, cold white fluorescent light cutting through the dark storm outside. In the foreground a young man, thin long face, single eyelids, slightly messy short black hair, lean build, wearing a dark blue short-sleeved uniform shirt under a matching vest with a badge on the left chest, his right hand gripping the glass door edge. The door pinches another man's wrist in the gap: the same face and hairstyle, soaked wet, hair plastered to his forehead, pale skin, the same dark blue uniform but darker from rain, no badge, barefoot. On that trapped wrist a pale old scar is visible. The clerk's eyes snap wide in shock, he releases the door, and the wet man steps calmly inside. Rain sound floods in, hard handheld camera jolt.

A 24-hour convenience store at midnight, harsh white fluorescent light, rain streaking the dark glass behind. Medium shot to close-up, handheld camera. A thin young man with a long narrow face, single eyelids, slightly messy short black hair, medium-slim build, wearing a dark blue short-sleeved uniform shirt under a matching vest, a name badge on his left chest, an old scar on his right wrist — he grabs the phone receiver, then stumbles backward into a shelf corner, fear on his face. A second man, identical face and hair but soaking wet, hair plastered to his forehead, pale skin, deeper-colored wet uniform, barefoot, climbs onto the checkout counter and pins a name badge to his chest. The camera follows the first man's retreat, then pans to the second. Cold tones, claustrophobic.
